payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED, tracking the source light-blue mug by its appearance, location, and visual context. Fulfillment requires the source mug itself to be visibly positioned to the right of the headphones; a different or newly appearing mug on the right does not establish this. For incomplete progress, credit concrete visual evidence that the source mug has displaced toward the headphones’ right side, even if blur or occlusion prevents confident identification at the destination. Do not infer movement merely from the source mug being absent or from an unrelated mug appearing elsewhere. If the images do not resolve whether the apparent displacement is of the source mug, treat the evidence as insufficient.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: compare the blue blurred remnant at the former left-side location with the white mug immediately left of/overlapping the headphones and the white mug farther right. The remnant and intervening mug may support displacement toward the headphones, but neither white mug alone establishes that the source mug is now to the right; distinguish this from the far-right white mug, which is not visibly the source blue mug.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
condition.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence that the source blue mug displaced toward the right of the headphones; absence at its source location or a different mug on the right alone does not count.
condition.half_when: The source blue mug shows concrete visual displacement toward the right of the headphones but is not visibly established as positioned to their right; for example, a blue remnant at its former location together with an intervening mug-like appearance may support incomplete movement, while continuity remains uncertain.
condition.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image; a different white mug on the right or ambiguous blur is not sufficient.
